content.text:
The booking grid now always shows times for the service, staff member and date currently selected, whatever order the responses arrive in. The fix is in `src/app/[slug]/wizard.tsx`, and the changes are uncommitted in the working tree.

The cause was that each slots request had no cancellation, so a slow response for an earlier date or staff member could overwrite the grid after a newer one had already rendered. Now the slots fetch lives in an effect that aborts its request when the selection changes, so a stale response is dropped. The manual reloads after a failed hold, a failed booking, and the "Back" button go through a small reload counter that retriggers the same effect.

Changing the selection while times are loading still works, because the new selection starts its own request immediately.

I checked with ESLint on the file (clean) and the unit tests (12 pass). The type check reports one error in `src/app/layout.tsx`, which I didn't touch. I could not run the booking flow in a browser or the integration tests, since Postgres and Redis aren't running here.
